findings.summary: RaycastAll orders by exact float distance with no kQueryTieTolerance, unlike the single-hit pick, so near-equal hits are ordered by float noise
findings.scenario: Two colliders whose entry distances differ by a few ulps (e.g. 4.5 vs 4.5000005 from an offset compound collider): Raycast::Single picks the lower handle (tie), RaycastAll()[0] is the other body, and PhysX and Jolt can round the two the opposite way and return different RaycastAll orders

findings.summary: Every PhysX single-hit query (Raycast::Single/Any, SphereCast, CapsuleCast) now runs a second touching scene query and value-initialises a 1024-entry hit buffer on the heap
findings.scenario: Picking and world-space UI call Raycast::Single every frame: each call now does two PhysX scene queries plus a ~tens-of-KB allocation and zeroing even when there is no tie; a perf regression versus the old single blocking query

findings.summary: The Design decisions table in index.html has no row for physics.html#design-jolt-queries (a 'for you to accept' callout), and the merge rewrote its decisions (5) and (6) (layer read from ColliderSpec::layer; Collide hits triggers on Jolt)
findings.scenario: A reader of the index's decision list does not see that the J5 query decisions exist or that (5)/(6) changed at the J4 merge; pre-existing gap in the reviewed head, now carrying changed decisions
